bullets.title: Understanding Safe Healthcare Environments
bullets.text: A safe healthcare environment protects patients, visitors and healthcare workers from preventable infection, injury and clinical harm. Safety does not depend only on policies or specialised equipment. It is created through the everyday decisions of healthcare professionals: keeping the environment uncluttered,…

bullets.title: Preventing Infection in Everyday Nursing Practice
bullets.text: Infection prevention is a core responsibility in every area of nursing. Microorganisms can spread through hands, equipment, body fluids, respiratory droplets, contaminated surfaces and invasive devices. bullets.text: Patients can be harmed by falls, medication errors, pressure injuries, incorrect identification, equipment failure and delays in recognising deterioration.
